def transform(g):
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    fill=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]
    H=[r for r in range(R) if all(g[r][c]!=fill for c in range(C))]
    V=[c for c in range(C) if all(g[r][c]!=fill for r in range(R))]
    mH=[r for r in H if any(g[r][c] not in (fill,line) for c in range(C))]
    mV=[c for c in V if any(g[r][c] not in (fill,line) for r in range(R))]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(mH)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(mV)-1):
            c=g[mH[i]][mV[j+1]]
            row.append(fill if c==line else c)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def transform(g):
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    fill=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]
    H=[r for r in range(R) if all(g[r][c]!=fill for c in range(C))]
    V=[c for c in range(C) if all(g[r][c]!=fill for r in range(R))]
    marked=lambda r,c: g[r][c] not in (fill,line)
    mH=[r for r in H if any(marked(r,c) for c in range(C))]
    mV=[c for c in V if any(marked(r,c) for r in range(R))]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(mH)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(mV)-1):
            corners=[g[mH[i+k]][mV[j+l]] for k in (0,1) for l in (0,1)]
            if all(marked(mH[i+k],mV[j+l]) for k in (0,1) for l in (0,1)):
                row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row.append(fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
